issues.originalQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer while leaving a less complete map.
issues.revisedQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer, but it will leave a less complete map.
issues.problem: Changes a possible tradeoff into a definite prediction that the map will be less complete.

issues.originalQuote: A local inventory may also contain outdated boundaries.
issues.revisedQuote: A local inventory might contain outdated boundaries, as no field measurements have been collected for this proposal [S1].
issues.problem: Adds an unsupported causal connection: the absence of field measurements for this proposal does not explain whether the inventory boundaries are outdated.

issues.originalQuote: Its contribution would be a more explicit account of what the available images can support.
issues.revisedQuote: Instead, its contribution will be a more explicit account of what the available images can support.
issues.problem: Replaces a conditional proposed contribution with a definite outcome, weakening the original uncertainty.
